title: Review concurrent clonidine and propranolol

rule_for_models: Check concurrent clonidine and propranolol at any age. Ask about pulse, blood pressure and the plan if treatment changes. Do not infer co-use from a documented switch or give instructions to stop either drug. Use supply dates, quantities and stated units per day to estimate shared treatment days. Apply documented taper or stop dates. Cite both supplies and any relevant taper entry. If directions are as needed or unclear and the courses could overlap, report only a possible finding. Ask the patient which medicines were taken together, at what doses and on which days. The reason either medicine was prescribed does not exclude concurrent use. Exclude courses shown to be separate.
cannot_be_seen: Dispensing does not establish actual use, indication or a prescriber’s intent. Treatment and assessments elsewhere may be missing. Pulse, blood pressure and a plan for changing treatment may be absent. Ask about recent readings and any plan the prescriber gave. Remind the patient to seek medical advice before stopping clonidine.
ask_the_gp: Could you review concurrent clonidine and propranolol, the patient's pulse and blood pressure, and the plan if either medicine is changed or stopped?
